author: martinamalberti
body:
#### PR description:
This PR adds the BTL packer (BTL digis -> raw data) and an Alpaka-based BTL unpacker (raw data -> BTL digis SoA), built on top of the BTL readout map and dense channel index introduced in #52571.

**Raw data format** (`EventFilter/MTDRawToDigi/interface/BTLRawDataFormat.h`)
- One SLinkRocket fragment (header + payload + trailer) per BTL FED (144 FEDs) in the `RawDataBuffer`.
- Payload: one 128-bit word per TOFHIR channel (header fields + TOFHIR data). The bit layout is provisional and will be updated once the BTL payload format is frozen.
- The `insertBits`/`extractBits` helpers are shared by the packer, the unpacker and the test analyzers.

**Packer** (`BTLDigiToRaw`, `stream::EDProducer`)
- For each `BTLDigi`, it writes two channel words (minus and plus side), with FED/HS-link/e-link/channel taken from the `BTLReadoutMap`.
- Within each FED the data are ordered by HS-link and e-link, as indicated by the MTD DAQ team.

**Unpacker** (`BTLRawToDigi`, Alpaka `SynchronizingEDProducer`)
- `acquire()`:
  - copies the FED payloads into a host staging buffer;
  - on the device, runs decoding of the channel words, search of the chip segments, pairing of the minus/plus channels and counting of the digis per chip, then the prefix scan of the digi offsets (`cms::alpakatools::prefixScan`);
  - the only device -> host copy is the total number of digis.
- `produce()`: fills the `BTLDigiDeviceCollection`, which is put in the event directly on the device. The copy to the host, when needed, is done automatically by the framework.
- Electronics -> DetId mapping: a new `BTLElectronicsToDetIdMapping` SoA ES product (`CondFormats/MTDObjects`, host and device). It is built by an Alpaka ESProducer from the readout map and indexed by `BTLElectronicsIndexing::denseChannelIndex`.

**`mtdRawData` process modifier and upgrade workflow `.32`**
- DIGI2RAW: the BTL packer is added, and `RawDataBuffer_btlDigiToRaw` is kept in the RAW event content.
- RAW2DIGI: the BTL unpacker is added.
- The BTL SoA local reconstruction (`btlBaseRecHitsSoA`) and the BTL digi SoA validation read the unpacker output. `btlDigiSoAProducer` is removed from the local reco task.
- New upgrade workflow `.32` (`_mtdRawData`), for TTbar and MinBias Run4 (e.g. 38434.32).
- The default workflows are not changed.

**Test tools** (`EventFilter/MTDRawToDigi/test`)
- `BTLRawToDigiValidator`: digi -> raw -> digi closure test.
- `DumpBTLRawDataBuffer`: dump of the raw data.
- `BTLRawOccupancyAnalyzer`: occupancy of the raw data.
- The corresponding cfgs

**References**
This development was presented at the following meetings:
- CMS developments with GPUs meeting, 19 October 2026: https://indico.cern.ch/event/1742178/#6-alpaka-based-btl-unpacker
- MTD DPG meeting, 20 November 2026: https://indico.cern.ch/event/1754613/#2-btl-packer-and-unpacker


#### PR validation:
- Tested on `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-23-2300`.
- Workflows 38434.0 and 38434.32 (TTbar D128, no PU), 10 events, 1 thread, up to harvesting: all steps pass.
- MTD Validation plots, compared bin by bin:
  - 38434.0 with this PR vs plain IB: all histograms identical;
  - 38434.32 vs 38434.0: all histograms identical, i.e. the local reconstruction from the unpacked digis gives the same results as the standard one.
- `BTLRawToDigiValidator` on TTbar PU200 D128 Aging1000 (10 events, CPU serial backend): all the digis are recovered identically.

This PR is not a backport
title: MTD: BTL packer and Alpaka-based unpacker, with mtdRawData process modifier
